title.sl: Na stezi za kegljanje na ledu

description.de: Die Stockbahn unter der Linde: der Asphalt (im Winter Eis), die Bande, die Daube, die Eisstöcke rot und grün, der Meterstab, die Laube mit Tisch und Krug, und wer gewinnt.
description.sl: Steza pod lipo: asfalt (pozimi led), ograja, tarča, rdeči in zeleni keglji, meter, brajda z mizo in vrčem, in kdo zmaga.
description.en: The curling lane under the linden: the asphalt (ice in winter), the side boards, the Daube, the red and green stocks, the folding rule, the arbour with its table and jug, and who wins.
description.it: La pista sotto il tiglio: l'asfalto (d'inverno ghiaccio), le sponde, il bersaglio, i birilli rossi e verdi, il metro, il pergolato con tavolo e brocca, e chi vince.

review: de, sl, en, it: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker; to check: die Stockbahn, die Daube, der Eisstock, die Bande, der Meterstab, die Laube

words.example_de: Die Stockbahn liegt unter der Linde.
words.example_en: The curling lane lies under the linden.
words.example_it: La pista è sotto il tiglio.
words.note: Stock + Bahn (lane): where Stockschießen, Alpine curling, is played; in summer on asphalt, in winter on ice.
words.note_sl: Stock + Bahn (steza): kjer se igra Stockschießen; poleti na asfaltu, pozimi na ledu.
words.note_it: Stock + Bahn (pista): dove si gioca allo Stockschießen; d'estate sull'asfalto, d'inverno sul ghiaccio.

words.example_de: Der Stock fährt gegen die Bande.
words.example_sl: Kegelj se zaleti v obrobno desko.
words.example_en: The stock runs into the side boards.
words.example_it: Il birillo va contro la sponda.
words.note: The low wooden boards along the lane; the same word as an ice rink's boards.
words.note_sl: Nizke lesene deske ob stezi; enaka beseda kot ob drsališču.
words.note_it: Le basse assi di legno lungo la pista; la stessa parola delle sponde di una pista di pattinaggio.

words.example_de: Im Sommer spielen wir auf dem Asphalt.
words.example_en: In summer we play on the asphalt.
words.note: Masculine, stressed on the last syllable in Austria: der Asphált. In winter the lane is flooded and freezes.
words.note_sl: Moškega spola. Pozimi stezo polijejo z vodo in zamrzne.
words.note_it: Maschile. D'inverno la pista viene bagnata e gela.

words.example_de: Mein Stock liegt ganz nah an der Daube.
words.example_sl: Moj kegelj leži čisto blizu tarče.
words.example_en: My stock is lying right by the target.
words.example_it: Il mio birillo è vicinissimo al bersaglio.
words.note: The small target disc at the far end; whoever's stock ends nearest it wins the round.
words.note_sl: Majhna tarča na drugem koncu; zmaga, čigar kegelj obstane najbližje.
words.note_it: Il piccolo bersaglio in fondo; vince chi ha il birillo più vicino.

words.example_de: Der Eisstock hat einen langen Stiel.
words.example_en: The curling stock has a long handle.
words.example_it: Il birillo ha un lungo manico.
words.note: A round flat body with an upright handle; on asphalt too it keeps its name. Plural with an umlaut: die Eisstöcke.
words.note_sl: Okroglo ploščato telo z ročajem; tudi na asfaltu mu rečejo tako. Množina s preglasom: die Eisstöcke.
words.note_it: Un corpo rotondo e piatto con il manico; si chiama così anche sull'asfalto. Plurale con l'Umlaut: die Eisstöcke.

words.example_en: Franz measures with the folding rule.
words.note: In Austria and the south the folding rule; in the north der Zollstock.
words.note_sl: V Avstriji in na jugu zložljivi meter; na severu der Zollstock.
words.note_it: In Austria e al sud il metro pieghevole; al nord der Zollstock.

words.example_de: Unter der Laube ist es kühl.
words.note: A little roof of laths with a climbing plant over a table.
words.note_sl: Strešica iz letev s plezalko nad mizo.
words.note_it: Un tettuccio di listelli con un rampicante sopra un tavolo.

words.note: Masculine in German, feminine in Slovene.
words.note_sl: V nemščini moškega spola: der Punkt.
words.note_it: Maschile come in italiano: der Punkt.

words.example_de: Opa Sepp schiebt den Stock ganz langsam.
words.example_sl: Opa Sepp potisne kegelj čisto počasi.
words.example_en: Opa Sepp slides the stock very slowly.
words.example_it: Nonno Sepp spinge il birillo pianissimo.
words.note: Irregular in the Perfekt: hat geschoben.
Irregular in the Perfekt: hat gewonnen.

words.example_de: Der Stock liegt ganz nah an der Daube.
words.example_en: The stock is lying right near the target.
words.example_it: Il birillo è vicinissimo al bersaglio.

words.note: Smooth, and on ice slippery: Vorsicht, glatt!
words.note_sl: Gladek, na ledu pa spolzek: Vorsicht, glatt!
words.note_it: Liscio, e sul ghiaccio scivoloso: Vorsicht, glatt!
